# S3.8 — the Stage-3 context/memory executables: `clear_tool_results`, the two-arm `lab/compaction-family-v1`, `trace_predicate` oracles, the compliance chain, privilege-preservation fixtures, `opacity_dynamic`, the re-lowering test, retrieval determinism, `structural_index` as a Lab arm, skills round trip (R-2.4.1…R-2.4.5 S3 slices)

**Spec:** `spec/CANONICAL_SPEC.md` §5c.1–§5c.5 (the Stage-3 slices)
**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/054_S3.8__context-memory-eval.md`
**Requirement ids stamped:** **R-2.4.1, R-2.4.2⁰, R-2.4.3, R-2.4.4,
R-2.4.5 (S3 slices)**
**Base:** `svitali/harnessharness-s3.7` (stacked) · **Stage:** 3 ·
**Live stage:** offline-only (all checks hermetic)
**ADR:** `docs/adr/ADR-0285-s3.8-context-memory-eval-rulings.md`

## Summary

**`clear_tool_results` executes.** `hh-context::compact` gains the
second compaction strategy: it evicts only targeted *completed* tool
invocations — required items and out-of-window items are never
evicted — and `context.compaction.completed` now carries
`label_after`/`reclaimed` (I-LABEL). The two-arm
`lab/compaction-family-v1` (`evict_oldest` vs `clear_tool_results`)
executes end-to-end under `MatchSpec{matched_cap, tolerance 0.10}`.

**`structural_index` is a real view.** Token-shape extraction
(anchors = path-like tokens + artifact paths; idents = `_`/`::`/
camelCase boundaries, OQ-203's Stage-3 scope — ADR-0285 D1) folded
into a `View`-stamped `StructuralIndex`; the `structural` query and the
deterministic integer `structural_pagerank` run over it. The on-demand
fold is the second implementation — indexed and on-demand retrieval
agree deterministically (AC-R-2.4.3-7), and `lab/retrieval-index-v1`
registers `structural_pagerank` as a Lab arm.

**The compliance chain folds.** `hh-eval` gains `trace_predicate`
oracles (reacquisition / repeated_action / recall_probe — deterministic
from events alone, `n/a{class}` without evidence) and the
`context_metrics` fold: overhead, compaction counts, the memory
compliance chain (`delivered` → `activated{tool_used}` → `followed`),
`memory.withheld`, `memory.over_invalidation`, and the derived ppm
rates `memory.validity_rate` and `memory.activated_given_delivered` —
every emitted row declared in the catalogue. `opacity_dynamic`
(median/P95 ppm) is verified. M-CPE/X-CPE fixtures prove external
memory never enters privileged slots.

**Procedures get their Stage-3 machinery.** `select_target` is total
and pure: `instruction` default, workflow-node feasibility, typed
refusals (`DelegationUnavailable`, `UnexpressibleSurface`), risk/
evidence gating, profile-owned target differences — and an explicitly
requested infeasible target refuses typed, never silently falls back
(AC-R-2.4.5-4). `test_procedure` returns `ProcedureConformance`
(unbudgeted / missing-`MatchSpec` refuse; revoked fixture →
`stale-by-dependency`; undecidable → `unknown`; instrument-budget cost
on a clean fixture). Skill `export` lifts a procedure back to a skill
tree with declared losses, claims-never-grants, opaque script payloads,
and a lift/export round trip. Hook guards emit only
`{narrow, additional_context?, replacement_proposal?}` — `allow` is
`GuardReturnsAllow`.

**The recipes register.** Five new exemplars land beside
`compaction-family-v1`: `lab/context-builder-v1` (AC-R-2.4.1-12's
matched arms — rp × catalogs × clearing), `lab/memory-compliance-v1`
(AC-R-2.4.3-9's external-slot vs promotion-endorsed),
`lab/memory-validity-v1` (AC-R-2.4.4-12's three-factor validity
recipe), `lab/procedure-execution-v1` (AC-R-2.4.5-10's
target × profile + interaction), `lab/retrieval-index-v1`.
